lg2_before.scope: Full synthetic source mapping, private replay ledger, projection, publication and expiry. Telemetry included in update elapsed time; compare paired modes from this harness. No production data or services. Index maintenance is included in statement execution cost.

sql.sql: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON
PRAGMA busy_timeout=1000
PRAGMA query_only=ON
SELECT json FROM configuration
PRAGMA user_version
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'
ATTACH DATABASE ? AS projection
PRAGMA main.journal_mode=DELETE
PRAGMA main.synchronous=FULL
PRAGMA main.cache_size=-4096
PRAGMA projection.journal_mode=DELETE
PRAGMA projection.synchronous=FULL
PRAGMA projection.cache_size=-4096
SELECT value FROM state WHERE key=?
SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM projection.sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type,name
SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type,name
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(messages)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(messages)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(interactions)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(interactions)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(source_provenance)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(source_provenance)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(selection_membership)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(selection_membership)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(watermarks)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(watermarks)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(coverage_history)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(coverage_history)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(durable_qualifications)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(durable_qualifications)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(qualification_events)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(qualification_events)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(legacy_generation_reports)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(legacy_generation_reports)
PRAGMA projection.table_xinfo(legacy_generation_witnesses)
PRAGMA table_xinfo(legacy_generation_witnesses)
SELECT * FROM operations ORDER BY number
SELECT * FROM evaluations ORDER BY number

SELECT r.message_id FROM projection.legacy_generation_reports r
        LEFT JOIN projection.messages m ON m.projection_row_id=r.message_id
        LEFT JOIN projection.source_provenance p ON p.entity_type='message' AND p.projection_row_id=r.message_id
        WHERE m.projection_row_id IS NULL OR p.projection_row_id IS NULL
        OR m.generation<>'UNKNOWN_LEGACY' OR p.raw_record_id IS NOT lower(hex(r.raw_ref)) LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM projection.legacy_generation_witnesses w LEFT JOIN projection.legacy_generation_reports r USING(raw_ref) WHERE r.raw_ref IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT p.* FROM projection.source_provenance p WHERE entity_type='message'
SELECT * FROM qualification_keys
SELECT count(*) FROM qualification_keys
SELECT count(*) FROM projection.durable_qualifications
SELECT * FROM audit_history
SELECT count(*) FROM audit_history
SELECT count(*) FROM projection.qualification_events
INSERT INTO state VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value
SELECT * FROM evaluations WHERE status!='COMPLETE'
SELECT * FROM evaluations ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO evaluations VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
SELECT raw_record_id FROM raw_network_records ORDER BY seq
SAVEPOINT router_projection_source_read

SELECT raw_record_id,cache_table,cache_rowid,raw_text_sha256 FROM compatibility_evidence_links WHERE raw_record_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) AND (cache_table IN ('messages','evidence_records','tclk_frames','kibble_events') OR raw_record_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)) ORDER BY raw_record_id,cache_table,cache_rowid

SELECT r.raw_record_id FROM raw_network_records r WHERE r.raw_record_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_network_records a WHERE a.room=r.room AND a.seq=r.seq AND a.raw_text_sha256=r.raw_text_sha256 AND a.raw_record_id<>r.raw_record_id)
RELEASE router_projection_source_read
SELECT * FROM evaluations WHERE number=?
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO input_versions VALUES(?,?,?)
INSERT INTO evaluation_inputs VALUES(?,?,?)
SELECT rowid AS projection_cache_rowid,* FROM kibble_events WHERE rowid IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
SELECT body,status FROM evaluations WHERE number=?
SELECT id,hash FROM evaluation_inputs WHERE number=? ORDER BY id
SELECT body FROM evaluation_edges WHERE number=? ORDER BY key
UPDATE evaluations SET body=?,event_id=? WHERE number=?
SELECT number,hash FROM operations ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO operations VALUES(?,?,?)
UPDATE evaluations SET status='SEALED' WHERE number=? AND status='STAGING'
SELECT * FROM evaluations WHERE status!='COMPLETE' ORDER BY number LIMIT 1
UPDATE evaluations SET status='APPLYING' WHERE number=?
SELECT i.id,i.hash,v.body FROM evaluation_inputs i JOIN input_versions v ON v.hash=i.hash WHERE i.number=? ORDER BY i.id
SELECT first_observed_at FROM current_inputs WHERE id=?

INSERT INTO current_inputs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET hash=excluded.hash,sender=excluded.sender,room=excluded.room,generation=excluded.generation,seq=excluded.seq,template=excluded.template,workflow_id=excluded.workflow_id WHERE current_inputs.hash IS NOT excluded.hash OR current_inputs.sender IS NOT excluded.sender OR current_inputs.room IS NOT excluded.room OR current_inputs.generation IS NOT excluded.generation OR current_inputs.seq IS NOT excluded.seq OR current_inputs.template IS NOT excluded.template OR current_inputs.workflow_id IS NOT excluded.workflow_id
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO evaluation_groups VALUES(?,?)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO source_aliases VALUES(?,?,?)

SELECT DISTINCT peer.sender FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.template FROM evaluation_inputs e JOIN current_inputs c ON c.id=e.id WHERE e.number=?) changed JOIN current_inputs peer ON peer.template=changed.template
SELECT DISTINCT c.sender FROM expiry e JOIN current_inputs c ON c.id=e.id WHERE e.due<=?
SELECT DISTINCT peer.sender FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.template FROM expiry e JOIN current_inputs c ON c.id=e.id WHERE e.due<=?) expired JOIN current_inputs peer ON peer.template=expired.template
SELECT id FROM current_inputs WHERE workflow_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY workflow_id,id
SELECT body FROM pins ORDER BY id
SELECT c.id FROM current_inputs c JOIN evaluation_groups g ON g.sender=c.sender WHERE g.number=? ORDER BY c.id
SELECT v.hash,v.body FROM current_inputs c JOIN input_versions v ON v.hash=c.hash WHERE c.id=?
BEGIN
SELECT raw_ref,reported_code FROM projection.legacy_generation_reports WHERE raw_ref IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT raw_ref,cache_kind,record_hash,locator FROM projection.legacy_generation_witnesses WHERE raw_ref IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ORDER BY raw_ref,cache_kind,record_hash,locator
SELECT annotations_json FROM projection.source_provenance WHERE entity_type='message' AND projection_row_id=?
SELECT reason FROM permanent WHERE id=?
SELECT root_json FROM pin_members WHERE id=? ORDER BY root_json
SELECT * FROM projection.messages WHERE room=? AND generation=? AND seq=?
SELECT * FROM projection.messages WHERE projection_row_id=?
SELECT * FROM projection.source_provenance WHERE entity_type='message' AND projection_row_id=?
SELECT * FROM projection.selection_membership WHERE entity_type='message' AND projection_row_id=?
INSERT INTO projection.watermarks VALUES(?,?,1,?,?) ON CONFLICT(room,generation) DO UPDATE SET record_count=record_count+1,min_seq=min(min_seq,excluded.min_seq),max_seq=max(max_seq,excluded.max_seq)

INSERT INTO projection.messages VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(projection_row_id) DO UPDATE SET room=excluded.room,generation=excluded.generation,seq=excluded.seq,timestamp=excluded.timestamp,sender=excluded.sender,signed=excluded.signed,text=excluded.text,normalized_text=excluded.normalized_text,template_normalized_hash=excluded.template_normalized_hash,nonce=excluded.nonce,sig=excluded.sig,message_hash=excluded.message_hash,verification_status=excluded.verification_status,source_export_hash=excluded.source_export_hash,source_export_path=excluded.source_export_path,evidence_id=excluded.evidence_id

INSERT INTO projection.source_provenance VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,projection_row_id) DO UPDATE SET source_namespace=excluded.source_namespace,source_record_locator=excluded.source_record_locator,scout_event_id=excluded.scout_event_id,raw_record_id=excluded.raw_record_id,raw_record_sha256=excluded.raw_record_sha256,annotations_json=excluded.annotations_json

INSERT INTO projection.selection_membership VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,projection_row_id) DO UPDATE SET retention_class=excluded.retention_class,retain_until=excluded.retain_until,pin_roots_json=excluded.pin_roots_json
INSERT INTO expiry VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET due=excluded.due

INSERT INTO projection.coverage_history VALUES(?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(room,generation) DO UPDATE SET max_ever_projected_seq=excluded.max_ever_projected_seq,witness_source_locator=excluded.witness_source_locator,witness_record_sha256=excluded.witness_record_sha256 WHERE excluded.max_ever_projected_seq>coverage_history.max_ever_projected_seq
INSERT INTO projection.legacy_generation_reports(raw_ref,reported_code) VALUES(?,?)
INSERT INTO projection.legacy_generation_witnesses VALUES(?,?,?,?)
SELECT sender FROM evaluation_groups WHERE number=? ORDER BY sender
SELECT count(*) FROM current_inputs WHERE sender=?
SELECT m.* FROM current_inputs c JOIN projection.messages m ON m.projection_row_id=c.id WHERE c.sender=? ORDER BY c.room,c.generation,c.seq,c.id
SELECT id FROM expiry WHERE entity_type='interaction' AND due<=? ORDER BY due,id LIMIT 200
UPDATE evaluations SET status='COMPLETE' WHERE number=?
PRAGMA projection.incremental_vacuum(200)
SELECT count(*) FROM evaluations WHERE status!='COMPLETE'
SELECT reported_code,count(*) FROM projection.legacy_generation_reports GROUP BY reported_code
SELECT coalesce(sum(n),0),coalesce(max(n),0) FROM (SELECT count(*) n FROM projection.legacy_generation_witnesses GROUP BY raw_ref)
SELECT length(CAST(CASE WHEN locator='' THEN lower(hex(record_hash)) ELSE locator END AS BLOB)),count(*) FROM projection.legacy_generation_witnesses GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM pin_exports
SELECT min(due) FROM expiry
